query: INSERT INTO streamer_plans (twitch_user_id, twitch_login, lurker_tax_enabled, lurker_pitch_enabled) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, COALESCE($4, 0)) ON CONFLICT (twitch_user_id) DO UPDATE SET lurker_tax_enabled = EXCLUDED.lurker_tax_enabled, lurker_pitch_enabled = COALESCE($4, streamer_plans.lurker_pitch_enabled), twitch_login = COALESCE(streamer_plans.twitch_login, EXCLUDED.twitch_login)
